name: AudienceView Unlimited (stub)
description: STUB. Ingestion-only AudienceView Unlimited catalog connector. Every URL path and every JSON field name inside set except the documented wrapper is a placeholder. Test connection and sync will not succeed against a live Unlimited host until the subscriber spec replaces /STUB.
use_cases: Hold the catalog shape for an Unlimited session-cookie ingest until the subscriber Web API spec names the real paths.

base_url.help: HTTPS origin only, with no path. Example shape: https://tickets.example.com. Leave this blank until /STUB paths in this package are replaced. Do not point Test connection at a live Unlimited host while the paths are still placeholders.

role.help: Unlimited user role for this login. The value is sent inside the login set object. The JSON key for it is still STUB_role.

sync_entity.description: Planned ingest label. These names are not confirmed Unlimited object names.

placeholders.{{BASE_URL}}: HTTPS origin of the Unlimited site. No path. Do not fill this while the package still calls /STUB.

connector_package.description: STUB AudienceView Unlimited package. Catalog HTTP session auth logs in with the cookie kept in memory for the run. Replace every /STUB path and every STUB_ field from the subscriber JSON v2 spec before any sync.
follow_up_notes: This package is a stub. catalog_visible is false so a template sync does not offer it in the Add Connector wizard.
Do not treat /STUB/session or /STUB/load as Unlimited URLs. The subscriber spec is unpublished. The 2012 Drupal av client paths were not copied.

Documented and used: POST bodies use a set element (Unlimited 7.27.1, AV-1411). An expired session is HTTP 200 with errorCode 99 (AV-1181). load returns a return array (AV-1588). records_path return is that load note, not a confirmed search envelope.

Not documented, so invented as obvious placeholders: login path, load path, cookie name (cookie_names is omitted), and every key inside set (STUB_username, STUB_password, STUB_role, STUB_object, STUB_after_id, STUB_limit).

Entity keys customers, orders, admissions, performances, and gifts are planned labels. cursor_field id is a placeholder monotonic field. The fetch must be replaced with a request ordered by the real cursor field and filtered to records newer than {{input.cursor}}.
Password is {{connection.password}} inside the login JSON body, never the URL. No write-back and no card or PAN fields.

Test connection runs audience_view_stub_load after session login. It fails until a real host and real paths replace this stub. Session auth itself ships with the connectors deploy and is not in production yet.
